source_scale: MZ; only up and down mass arrays are read. The semileptonic and nuclear coefficients must be matched to the same weak current over the selected low-energy windows.
charged_contract: Use unchanged leptonic charged current and Gmu, matched low-energy vector currents and thresholds, nuclear radiative corrections and QCD form factors. No squared CKM unitarity fit. Sum the published separate charm errors in absolute magnitude including the QED bracket.

all_active_example.role: chosen positive free phase and angle for an explicit competing realization matching only the two held-out moduli and running quark spectra
